delta: # Story 04 — CUSTOMERS-2-WEB customer screen: contacts, open tickets and

notes in one screen (Story: CRM-58)

## Prerequisites

- `CUSTOMERS-1-API (CRM-55)` and `CUSTOMERS-2-API (CRM-57)` completed — the composite `GET

/api/v1/customers/:id` returning customer, open tickets and notes in one request must exist before this screen ships.
- `TICKETS-1-API (CRM-71)` completed — status

/priority values on the ticket rows come from that story.
- `TICKETS-2-WEB (CRM-72)` completed — `/tickets/new` route ex

ists so the empty state can link to it.
- `CUSTOMERS-1-WEB (CRM-56)` completed — this story reuses the `useRequest`/`

Card`/`EmptyState` shape it established for the customer list.
- Read `.squad/plan-lessons.md` first. Do

not repeat any listed defect.

---

## Story Goal

Add a customer detail screen at `/customers/:id` for the agent. On load it mak

es **one** request to `GET /api/v1/customers/:id` and renders:

1. The customer's contact block (name, email, phone) — read-only.
2. Their **open** tickets (id, sub

ject, status, priority) as a list — status and priority rendered from resource-file words, not raw API values (BR-6).
3.

Their notes list (author, timestamp, body) — read-only.
4. Four states from `useRequest`: loading (skeleton), success
, empty (customer has no open tickets → CTA to `/tickets/new` per D-2), error (message from `t.errors[code]` +

Retry).

Explicitly **out of scope**: writing/editing notes (that is `CUSTOMERS-3-WEB (CRM-61)`), full ticket history (`TICKETS-7-WE

B (CRM-84)`), any `api/` change (`CUSTOMERS-2-API (CRM-57)`).

---

status"). Match this shape exactly.

(id)` hook follows the same shape.

ixes `/api/v1`** (`base-url.ts:3`). Do **not** pass `/api/v1/customers/:id`; pass `/customers/:id`. CRM-72's tests catch the

ing:

---

## Product

rules (from story)

- **Current:** no customer detail screen exists; agents only see the list at `/customers`.
- **New:**

- `/customers/:id` renders the composite payload from a **single** request.
  - Status and priority render as resource-file words (BR-6), never raw API codes.
- Empty state (customer with no open tickets) says so and offers to raise one — a link to `/tickets/new?customerId=:id` (D-2).

- Error state renders `t.errors[code]` and a Retry button re-runs the same `useRequest`.

---

---

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Unknown `:id` / customer not found** → API returns `404` with a documented code (e.g. `customer_not_found`). Render `
<ErrorState>` with `t.errors.customer_not_found`; Retry is still visible (user may have typed the wrong id in the URL) — enforced in `CustomerDetailPage.tsx` error

branch.
- **Empty `openTickets` array** → render the D-2 empty state with the "Raise a ticket" link; do **not** render the tickets `Card` at all.
- **Empty `not
es` array** → render the notes `Card` with `t.customerDetail.noNotes` inside; do not hide the section, agents rely on it being present

.
- **Network error / offline** → `useRequest` sets `status = 'error'` with a synthetic code; the error branch falls back to `t.errors.unknown` — enforced by

the `t.errors[error.code] ?? t.errors.unknown` expression in the render.
- **Slow response** → skeleton is visible until `status` flips off `p

ending`; no spinner + skeleton combo.
- **`:id` with URL-unsafe characters** → `encodeURIComponent(id)` in `useCust

omerDetail` — see task 2.
- **Retry after error** → `retry()` (returned from the hook) calls the same `run(() => request(...))` and resets the `useRequest

` state via the hook's own reducer; no manual state juggling.
- **RTL rendering (Arabic)** → all
layout uses `Stack` primitives from `web/src/shared/ui/`; no hand-authored `margin-left` / `text-align:

left` (`no-mirrored-styles.test.ts` in `web/src/shared/i18n/` catches these).
- **Stale request when `:id` changes** → the `useCallback` depend

ency `[id, run]` re-fires `useEffect`; `useRequest`'s internal cancellation drops the older response.
- **Sil

ent regression on request count** → covered by the explicit "one request" assertion in the test plan below.

---

## Test Plan

Add all tests under
`web/src/pages/customers/`. Match the style of `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.test.tsx` and `web/src/pages/tickets/TicketQueuePage.test.tsx`. Every

`fetch` stub must build a **fresh `Response` per call** (L-30).

1. **Create** `web/src/pages/customers/CustomerDetailPage.test.tsx` with cases:
   1
. **One request on load.** Stub `global.fetch`; render at `/customers/abc123`; wait for the contact heading; `expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeen

CalledTimes(1)`. This is an acceptance criterion — a screen that happens to make one today and four next month must fail this assertion.
   2.
**Renders contact, open tickets and notes** from a single payload. Assert the customer name, an open ticket subject, and a note body

are all in the DOM.
   3. **Status and priority render as words**, not raw codes. Payload has `status: 'pending'`,
`priority: 'urgent'`; assert `t.ticketQueue.statusPending` and `t.ticketQueue.priorityUrgent` text appear; assert `'pending'` and `'urgent'` (the raw

codes) do **not** appear.
   4. **Empty tickets → CTA (D-2).** Payload with `openTickets: []`; assert `t.customerDetail.noOpenTicketsB

ody` is in the DOM and a link with `href` matching `/tickets/new?customerId=abc123` is rendered.
   5. **Error → coded message + Retry.** First
fetch rejects with `{ code: 'customer_not_found' }`; assert `t.errors.customer_not_found` is rendered; second (fresh) `Response` resolves; click

Retry; assert success content appears and `fetchMock.mock.calls.length === 2`.
   6. **Unknown error code falls back to `t.errors.unknown`.**

7. **Loading state renders skeleton** before the fetch resolves.

2. **Modify** `web/src/pages/tickets/TicketQueuePage.test.tsx` — no behaviour change exp

ected; run after task 1 to prove the extracted `ticket-labels.ts` module keeps existing assertions green.

3. **Add** a test in `web/src/p
ages/tickets/` (or extend `TicketQueuePage.test.tsx`) that imports `{ statusLabel, priorityLabel }` from `./ticket-labels` directly and asserts each of the six status

codes and four priority codes maps to the expected `t.ticketQueue.*` string. This locks the mapping in one place.

4. **Rely on** `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts` to

catch a missing `ar.ts` key — do not duplicate its checks.

5. **Rely on** `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` — do not add a page-

local variant.

---

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend runs:** `cd web && npm run dev` — visit `/customers/abc123` against a running API;

confirm one network request in DevTools, empty and error states behave.
2. **Frontend t
ests:** `cd web && npm test` — full vitest suite passes, including the new `CustomerDetailPage.test.tsx`, the extracted-label test, `parity.test.ts`

, `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`, `no-mirrored-styles.test.ts`.
3. **Frontend build:** `cd web && npm run build` — `tsc -b && vite build` succ

eeds. The web suite does not typecheck in `npm test`; only `npm run build` proves types.
4. **Regression:** `cd web && npm test -- T

icketQueuePage` — existing ticket queue tests still pass after the label extraction.
5. **No AI attribution:** `git grep -inE "co
-authored-by|generated by|assisted by|copilot|chatgpt|claude|anthropic|openai" -
- web/` returns empty. `git log -n 20 --format='%B'` shows no such l

ines either.
6. **No double prefix:** `git grep -n "/api/v1/customers" web/src/pages/customers/` returns empty (the prefix is added by `base-url.ts`).

---

## Done

Criteria

- [ ] `/customers/:id` route mounts `CustomerDetailPage`.
- [ ] `useCustomerDetail(id)` makes exactly **one** `GET /custom

ers/:id` request per load, verified by a call-count assertion in the test file.
- [ ] Customer contact, open tickets and notes render from one payload.
- [ ] Ticket status and priority render from

`t.ticketQueue.status*` / `priority*` via the shared `web/src/pages/tickets/ticket-labels.ts` module (BR-6). No raw codes visible.
- [ ] Emp

ty state (no open tickets) shows the D-2 sentence and a link to `/tickets/new?customerId=:id`.
- [ ] Error state shows `t.errors[error.code]` (with

`t.errors.unknown` fallback) and a working Retry.
- [ ] `en.ts` and `ar.ts` updated in the same edit; `parity.test.ts` passes.
- [ ] `no-hardcoded-strings.test.

ts` and `no-mirrored-styles.test.ts` pass.
- [ ] `cd web && npm test` and `cd web && npm run build` both green.
- [ ] `TicketQueuePage.tsx` no longer defines `statusL

abel` / `priorityLabel` locally; it imports them from `./ticket-labels`.
- [ ] No file under `api/` was modified.
- [ ] No AI-attribution string in

any diff, doc, or commit message.
